Services

Everything a service business needs from its website, from first design to long-term care.

What we offer

  • Website design and build

    A complete site designed around how your customers decide, built to load quickly on any device.

    • Page structure and wording planned before design starts
    • Mobile-first design and development
    • An editor your staff can use for everyday changes
    • Contact forms, booking links and call buttons that work

  • Redesigns

    Keep what already works and replace what doesn’t, without losing the search rankings you’ve earned.

    • Review of your current site, content and traffic
    • Redirects from old page addresses to new ones
    • Content tidy-up and rewriting where needed
    • Move to faster, more secure hosting

  • Local search setup

    Help people in your city or region find you when they search for what you do.

    • Service pages and location pages
    • Google Business Profile setup and clean-up
    • Page titles, descriptions and structured data
    • Basic analytics so you can see where inquiries come from

  • Accessibility

    A site more people can use, built to WCAG 2.2 AA, which also supports ADA and AODA compliance efforts.

    • Keyboard and screen reader testing
    • Readable colors, text sizes and form labels
    • Accessible PDFs and media on request
    • An accessibility statement for your site

  • Writing and content

    Clear wording is half of a good website. We can write it, or edit what you already have.

    • Page copy in a plain, confident voice
    • Staff bios and service descriptions
    • Photo direction and image sourcing
    • Content for FAQs, forms and error messages

  • Care plans

    After launch, we keep your site fast, secure and up to date so you can get on with your work.

    • Software updates, backups and uptime monitoring
    • Small content changes each month
    • Security fixes and technical support
    • A short report on how the site is performing

Not sure what you need?

Send us your current site and we’ll tell you what’s worth fixing, free.
